## Problem you are trying to solve

<!--
Describe the situation that motivates this request. What are you trying to
do, and where do you get stuck today? Concrete examples help more than
abstract requirements.
-->

## Proposed solution

<!--
How would you like this to work? A rough shape is fine; the maintainer will
refine the design before any implementation work. Pseudo-code, mockups,
or example invocations welcome.
-->

## Alternatives considered

<!--
Have you explored workarounds with existing features (MCP servers, custom
tools, alternative LLM backends, etc.)? What did you try? Why were they
not enough?
-->

## Additional context

<!--
Anything else that might be useful: links to similar features in other
runtimes, related issues, screenshots of
the desired UX, etc.
-->
